description:
Read only the profiler report from the previous task and produce an executable NAS search space plan in JSON.
Behavior requirements: - Be conservative and pragmatic. - Prefer simple, well-established model families. - Include only model families clearly supported by profiler evidence. - Use small, bounded, realistic hyperparameter ranges. - Prefer categorical choices and small discrete ranges over wide continuous spaces. - Express uncertainty when profiler evidence is incomplete.
Strict constraints: - Do not inspect raw datasets. - Do not call dataset inspection tools. - Do not train models. - Do not run Optuna. - Do not evaluate model performance. - Do not select a final model.
Output must be strict JSON only (no markdown, no code fences, no prose before/after JSON).
\n\nInput: use only the profiler report generated by the previous task.

key_constraints: Low sample-to-feature ratio (2660:2500) indicating high overfitting risk
Sequential feature relationship requiring temporal or local feature extraction

selected_model_families.rationale: CNNs are standard for 1D signal data like ECG to extract local temporal patterns and spatial correlations while sharing weights to limit parameter count.
Simple baseline for fixed-length numeric vectors; requires heavy regularization due to dimensionality constraints.

uncertainty_notes: Sampling frequency is unknown, making it difficult to determine the physical significance of kernel sizes.
The 56 duplicate rows may lead to data leakage if not handled before splitting.
The 1:1 sample-to-feature ratio makes validation performance highly sensitive to model capacity.
handoff_notes: Prioritize models with fewer parameters to mitigate overfitting.
Ensure 1D convolution is applied across the feature dimension (2500).
Use Stratified K-Fold validation given the small dataset size and balanced classes.
The 'Target' column must be encoded (Normal: 0, Sleep Apnea: 1) before training.
